summary:
This PR makes API, web, and Playwright ports configurable so parallel local lanes can run without colliding.
- Centralizes port normalization and URL resolution.
- Derives API CORS defaults and Vite settings from configurable ports.
- Updates analytics and E2E callers to use the resolved API and web origins.
- Adds unit, API, and E2E coverage for dynamic-port behavior.
confidenceReasoning:
The PR is not safe to merge until required CI jobs stop targeting the retired self-hosted runner pool.

The dynamic-port changes leave the previously reported workflow configuration unchanged, and every CI job still selects the retired self-hosted pool, so required validation can remain queued or fail before testing the branch.

**Files Needing Attention:** .github/workflows/ci.yml
